articles.title: In 2016, Nevada rancher David Park began protecting Desert Creek Ranch; its 1,228 acres are now permanently conserved for agriculture and sage-grouse habitat, and a 2026 grant will treat invasive grass on 350 acres
articles.description: David Park has successfully conserved 1,228 acres of land at Desert Creek Ranch in Nevada. This effort focuses on protecting habitats for the rare Bi-State sage-grouse while allowing continued agricultural activities. A permanent conservation agreement prevents non-agricultural development and preserves the land's ecological value. Additionally, a future grant will facilitate restoration work across 350 acres to control invasive grass and support biodiversity.
